_comment: One data-quality rule per entry. `valid_when` is a SQL condition that a GOOD row satisfies; it runs as REGISTER DQ in Zetaris and as WHERE NOT (...) in SQLite.

rules.name: has_coordinates
rules.valid_when: lat IS NOT NULL AND lon IS NOT NULL

rules.name: in_cocoa_belt
rules.valid_when: lat BETWEEN 4.3 AND 10.8 AND lon BETWEEN -8.6 AND -2.5
